AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.

17. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

20. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

21. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
